total.description: Total readings matching the filters (all pages).

total_pages.description: Number of pages for this query.

has_more.description: True if there are more pages after this one.

reading_type.description: measurement (gauge, characteristic, condition monitoring) or continuous.

filters.description: Normalized filters applied, by parameter name.

fields_unavailable.description: Requested fields this reading type or this Maximo does not have; left out of the items.

items.description: Readings in this page, ordered by site, asset, meter and reading date (oldest first). Only the requested fields are present; dates are yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss in server time.

meters.description: Meters of the readings in this page: metername, description, metertype, measureunitid (unit), domainid.

points.description: Only for measurement: condition monitoring points of the readings in this page, with limits (upperwarning, lowerwarning, upperaction, loweraction; null = no limit).

error.description: Present only when the request is invalid. No other field is returned.
